:''The term "Weil algebra" is also sometimes used to mean a finite-dimensional real local [[Artinian ring]]''.
{{Distinguish | Weyl algebra}}
 
In [[mathematics]], the '''Weil algebra''' of a [[Lie algebra]] ''g'', introduced by {{harvs|txt|last=Cartan|authorlink=Henri Cartan|year=1951}} based on unpublished work of [[André Weil]],  is a [[differential graded algebra]] given by the [[Koszul algebra]] Λ(''g''*)⊗''S''(''g''*) of its dual ''g''*.
